localizedValues.name: Friends Barn
localizedValues.description:
Groups MUST contact the park in advance at (360) 344-4412 for a Special Activity Permit for weddings over 20 people and special equipment (i.e. canopies, dunk tanks, inflatable bouncer toys, climbing walls, or similar items).
The fully enclosed Friends Barn is located near the lower parking lot, close to the beach access trail. The Barn interior is 49' x 30'. It has lights, propane forced air heat, a gas fireplace, 10 electrical outlets, refrigerator, 10-foot wide projection screen, 20 six-foot tables, 1 three-foot table and 100 chairs. There is a large fire pit with 15 picnic tables and a large charcoal BBQ. A Restroom is located nearby. There is an amphitheater nearby that can be rented separately. Parking is shared with the general public and fills up quickly. A Discover Pass is required on all vehicles.

localizedValues.name: Amphitheater
localizedValues.description:
Groups MUST contact the park in advance at (360) 344-4412 for a Special Activity Permit for weddings over 20 people and special equipment (i.e. canopies, dunk tanks, inflatable bouncer toys, climbing walls, or similar items).
The Amphitheater can seat approximately 45 people on bench seats, and there is standing room for another 55. The Friends Barn is located nearby and can be rented separately. Parking is shared with the general public and fills up quickly. A Discover Pass is required on all vehicles.

localizedValues.name: G1
localizedValues.description:
The group camp includes the historic Torpedo X-ray building, water spigots and two vault toilets. It can accommodate up to two RVs but there are no utilities. Maximum parking is for 10 vehicles.
There is a minimum billable party size for this site. The unit price for a block of people may not accurately reflect the total price required. Confirm total payment at checkout.
